parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the clock, made of plastic, circular in shape, and provides structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the clock surface and internal mechanism in place, protecting them from damage.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of lightweight aluminum, short and thick compared to other hands.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour on the clock face by rotating slowly around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 12 hours.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of aluminum, longer and thinner than the hour hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes on the clock face by rotating around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 60 minutes.

parts.name: Second Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the second hand of the clock, made of steel, thin and lightweight, often colored red for visibility.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the seconds on the clock face by rotating continuously around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 60 seconds.

parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the front transparent surface of the clock, made of glass, covering the hands and dial.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the clock hands and dial from dust and physical damage while allowing visibility.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.
